protocol.selection: All 16 basic trials must pass survival and recovery; rank mean noisy unforced wrist RMS, then action-rate RMS. Compare to baseline.
protocol.caveat: Finite native CPU MuJoCo tests; no hardware validation or guarantee for stronger/different loads.

selection_rationale: Retain checkpoint 15000 for low-jitter standing under the current noise model. It passed all 16 basic trials, had the lowest noisy-standing wrist RMS across all 11 saved candidates, and remained lowest on five fresh noise seeds. Later checkpoints improve averaged training reward/tracking and all-joint smoothness, but do not beat this wrist-motion result. Differences among 15000,16500,17000 are small; hardware sensor calibration remains necessary.
